start_here: Say to your AI: "Run workflow:act-on-my-notice with database <the name of my own account database>, id told:1 and action open."
no_lists_because: The offered action is the notice's own url in the person's own database; no list of yours is needed.
instructions: 1. Name the database your account keeps its rows in.
2. Say "Run workflow:act-on-my-notice" with database, the notice id and the action it offered (open).

3. A local open answers the path to open and marks the notice read; a reply (action reply with text) is kept on the notice once as answer_text; any other action is refused with the owner that must act.

worked_examples.title: Open the report a notice offered
worked_examples.ask: Open the report notice told:1 offered
worked_examples.given: The notice table holds told:1 with url /work/reports/1, unread.
worked_examples.hands_back: done true, said "Opening the notice.", open "/work/reports/1"; told:1 is now read and acted.
